pokedexEntries.bk: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

pokedexEntries.wh: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey’s location and state.

pokedexEntries.sw: Venipede and Sizzlipede are similar species, but when the two meet, a huge fight ensues.

pokedexEntries.sh: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.
